objective: To process the destination mapping file uploaded from the Cross Dock Part Master screen (Export Crossdock Master tab): from the [Validate file] button of the Upload Excel modal until the mapping of the ongoing calculation period is saved to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST.
In case any error occurs, nothing is saved. The error is recorded in the upload log and a result report is created.

steps: User clicks [Validate file] in the Upload Excel modal of the Export Crossdock Master screen (ongoing period). The batch starts and receives the uploaded file.

steps.text: Check the file: format .xlsx, size, number of rows, sheet "Upload" and template columns (see 4.1).
children: If the file is not valid, reject the upload and go to step 7.

steps: Read all rows of sheet "Upload" and group them by Part Number.

steps.text: Check every row and every part against the business rules (see 4.2) and collect all errors.
children: A placeholder row (Destination Code and Dest Case/Day both blank) is skipped.

steps.text: If any row has an error, reject the whole file. Nothing is saved and the errors are recorded in the upload log.
If all rows are valid, compare each part with its current mapping of the ongoing period (see 4.3).
children: Same destinations and Case/Day: skip the part (no change).

Otherwise: update / insert / delete the destinations of the part so that its mapping matches the rows of the file, and call SP_STG_WRITE per added / changed / removed destination (Export ADD / EDIT / DELETE).
A part whose rows are all blank is not changed.

steps: Create the result report and record the result (completed or rejected) in the upload log. The Export Crossdock Master screen shows the result to the user. Exit.

func_desc.text: This batch starts when the user clicks [Validate file] in the Upload Excel modal of the Export Crossdock Master screen. It checks the uploaded file and, if everything is valid, updates the mapping of the changed parts for the ongoing calculation period. If not, the upload is rejected and recorded in the upload log.

items: Only sheet "Upload" of the file is read. Parts that are not in the sheet are not changed.
Only the ongoing calculation period is changed; past periods are read only.
One run saves all parts or none (all-or-nothing).

The columns Total Case/Day (used) and Max Case/Day (quota) are for reference only and are not read; the limit is Max Case/Day of the part in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and used is calculated from Dest Case/Day.
File extension is .xlsx.
File size is 5 MB or less.
Sheet Upload has 1 to 5,000 data rows.
Sheet "Upload" exists. Other sheets are ignored.
Header has the 6 template columns (see Appendix), found by column name (case and leading / trailing spaces ignored). Extra columns are ignored.

func_desc.text: Every row is checked and all errors are collected, so the user can correct the file once. Checks 4 and 6 are done per part (all rows with the same Part Number).

items: If any row is rejected, nothing is saved. The upload status and the error of every row are recorded in the upload log (Log).

If all rows are valid, each part in the file is compared with its current mapping of the ongoing period. A part with the same destinations and Case/Day is skipped (no change); its Sync Status and last update stay.

For a changed part, its rows of the ongoing period in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST are compared with the rows of the file by destination code (key PART_NO + PERIOD + DEST_CODE): a destination in both with a different Case/Day is updated (CASE_DAY, CHANGED_BY, CHANGED_DT; CREATED_BY / CREATED_DT are kept), a destination only in the file is inserted, a destination only in the table is deleted, and a destination with the same Case/Day is not touched. All changes are saved in one transaction.
A part whose rows are all blank (placeholder) is not changed, so a mapping cannot be removed completely by upload (same as the screen: at least one destination).
Every changed part gets a history record per added, changed or removed destination in TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE (event MAPPING, source UPLOAD, DEST_CODE and FIELD_NAME CASE_DAY; refer Appendix).

Every added / changed / removed destination goes to the staging through SP_STG_WRITE (SOURCE UPLOAD, UPLOAD_ID): an Export row, a GTOPAS row when the destination appears or disappears for the part, and the Kanban header (OPERATION_TYPE 5) when the Kanban did not change. File rows equal to the current mapping write nothing. The part is sent by the next [Sync].
A result report (.xlsx) is created for both cases.

rows: Part No exists in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and its status is Active.
Destination code exists in TB_M_H0125_DESTINATION (Destination Master, DESTINATION_CD).
Dest Case/Day is a whole number greater than 0 when Destination Code is filled.
A destination code + order type appears only once per part in the file (the same destination with another order type is allowed).
Destination Code and Dest Case/Day are both filled, or both blank (placeholder row). Only one of the two filled is an error.
The total Dest Case/Day of all rows of a part does not exceed the Max Case/Day of the part in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (Max Case/Day (quota) of the file is ignored). Below or equal is allowed.
The upload is for the ongoing calculation period only (the screen enables [Validate file] only for that period).
upload is A or E. A only for a destination that is not yet mapped for the part, E only for a destination that is already mapped (ongoing period). A placeholder row left blank is skipped.

items: Order Type per destination row (system master '**', 'C', '9', 'V'): the same destination may have two rows in a period when the order type differs; key PART_NO + PERIOD + DEST_CODE + ORDER_TYPE.
Template: new column Order Type after Destination Code (mandatory, '**', 'C', '9' or 'V'). A destination + order type twice for a part in the file = row error (message of the duplicate check).
The upload changes the ongoing period only; Next (made by XD05) and past periods are not changed.
Every save calls the stored procedure SP_STG_WRITE once per changed value, in the same transaction and after the master tables are updated. A save without a changed value writes nothing.

Export (TB_H_STG_APPOLE_EXPORT): one row per added (ADD), changed (EDIT) or removed (DELETE, Max Shipping Box (RCS) 0) destination + order type. Active -> Inactive writes DELETE (0) for every destination of the part.

GTOPAS (TB_H_STG_GTOPAS): a row only when the destination appears or disappears for the part (any order type) and GTOPAS does not have that state yet. A Case/Day change or an order type change of a destination that stays writes no GTOPAS row.

Header: an Export change of a part + period without an unsent Kanban row writes the Kanban header with ACTION KEEP and OPERATION_TYPE 5 (current Kanban values, not uploaded). So every part of a run has one Kanban row that sets its upload order. The header is deleted when no Export row of the part + period waits any more.

One unsent row per key: a key has at most one row with SYNC_STATUS 0. A new change of the key updates that row (value, ACTION, OPERATION_TYPE, CHANGED_BY / CHANGED_DT); a change back to the value already sent for the period deletes it (nothing to send); a sent row (SYNC_STATUS 1) is never changed, the next change inserts a new row. Keys: Kanban PERIOD + PART_NO; Export PERIOD + NSP_PART_NO + DEST_CODE + ORDER_TYPE; GTOPAS PERIOD + P_NO + DESTINATION_CODE. TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE keeps every change.
NSP keeps the end state valid before the save: total Case/Day of the destinations <= Max Case/Day of the part in the period (XD01 messages 14 and 20, XD02 / XD03 checks).
SOURCE UPLOAD, UPLOAD_ID of the upload. The part is sent by the next [Sync] (refer XD01 5.24).

Rules and simulation: deliverables/function_list_v2/erd/proposal_staging_sync (Proposal_Tables_Staging_Per_Target.xlsx, simulation/Staging_Header_Order.html, simulation/Staging_Per_Target_Full_Flow_Simulation.xlsx).
